tunnel.title: Tunnel
tunnel.desc: Access device services via public network
tunnel.installingHint: Installing, please wait (deploying frps on your server, then frpc on the device; about 1-2 minutes)
tunnel.serverInstalled: Server installed. Now installing frpc on the device...
tunnel.uninstallMsg: Uninstall the tunnel? This removes both the client on the device and the frps server.
tunnel.uninstallMsgClientOnly: Uninstall the tunnel? This removes the client on the device (the server frps is not removed because no server credentials were provided).
tunnel.installQueued: Tunnel install task submitted; track progress in the task panel
tunnel.uninstallQueued: Tunnel uninstall task submitted; track progress in the task panel
tunnel.exposeHint: Public ports are assigned by the server and appear here after installation
tunnel.dialogAlert: frps will be deployed automatically on your server, and frpc will be installed on the selected device
tunnel.guideWhatDesc: Tunneling exposes services running on a private-network device to the public internet, so you can reach them from anywhere.
tunnel.guideStep1: Prepare a Linux server with a public IP
tunnel.guideStep2: Select the target device, click "Install", and fill in the server address and SSH credentials
tunnel.guideStep3: Click "One-click Install": frps is deployed on your server and frpc is installed on the device
tunnel.guideStep4: After installation, reach the device through the public server's ports
tunnel.guideStep5: Click "Web Panel" to visually manage and configure proxy rules
tunnel.guideParamServer: Server Address: the public IP of your server
tunnel.guideParamSSHPort: SSH Port: the server's SSH login port (default 22)
tunnel.guideParamFrpsPort: frps Bind Port: the port frps listens on (default 7000)
